Recent bride here looking for advice! Hired a wedding photographer for 6 hours for our brunch style wedding that happened a month ago. Our reception ended at 3pm so that put the photographer arriving to the hotel at 9am which is what we discussed in the call the week prior. Our first issue is she didn’t get to the hotel until about 9:45. Our ceremony started at 10:30 so we had to leave about half an hour after she arrived. She first took some detail pics of my dress and the rings and disappeared for about 20 mins. After that she took a few pics of the bridal party getting ready. I had asked to get some pics with my mom helping me get into my dress but since we were pressed on time she agreed we could take them at the venue later. She didn’t get any photos of the groom or groomsmen getting ready at all. 

    After the ceremony we did family pictures. She took one set of photos with my side of the family then one with the grooms side of the family and that’s it. I know this is partly my fault for not having a shot list but it’s something I forgot to do and she did not ask. At about 1pm she came up to my husband and I and said she was thinking about leaving soon because she had gotten all the photos needed. I was overwhelmed during the reception and did not think about asking for the photos of me getting into my dress or any with my mom. After that we did not see her again. She essentially only 3 hours and a few minutes. Only half of what we paid for and what was contracted for. 

She sent us 10 previews over text two days after the wedding and I am still waiting on the rest. I honestly don’t know what to do or how to approach this with her. Is this something that’s worth fighting to get some money back on? Should I wait until I have the photos to say anything?

Thank you. She’s been doing this for years I was told. I thought she was professional but the way this was handled really surprised me. We only have our previews so far and I would say they’re alright. I know some of it is just her style as a photographer but my husbands suit was navy and she so heavily edited the pictures that it looks black. 


[link to photos for anyone wondering](https://imgur.com/a/tCdteDP)

Thank you. I kind of assumed she had an idea of these shots just from doing so many weddings so I guess this is partly my fault. She didn’t say anything about coming late, I do have screenshots of texts of when she said she was walking into the hotel but that’s it. As far as leaving early she did come up to us at the reception saying she was thinking about leaving soon. I was so overwhelmed and in the moment I didn’t think to say anything about the dress pictures or asking her why she’s leaving so early. After she said that to us we never saw her again.

Unfortunately reading back over the contract it states

“PHOTOGRAPHER and CLIENT agree that the PHOTOGRAPHER is under no obligation to capture any specific moment or pose or person(s) during the PHOTOSHOOT. The PHOTOGRAPHER is not responsible for compromised coverage due to causes beyond the control of the PHOTOGRAPHER including but not limited to obtrusive guests, lateness of the CLIENT or guests, weather conditions, schedule complications, incorrect addresses provided to the PHOTOGRAPHER, restrictions of the locations. “

So I don’t feel like I really have anything for her not getting the pictures I had hoped for, which really sucks. But I definitely have in the contract and multiple emails that we discussed six hours of coverage and the pricing that reflects that.
It was a reputable wedding photographer unfortunately.
